about:
John Celli Custom Furniture Designs, Inc. is based in New Milford, Connecticut. The company traces its roots to 1967 when founder John "JC" Celli established JC Furniture. Today the business is owned by his son and daughter, continuing a family-owned operation that began with a focus on seating and grew into a full-service furniture resource.

The firm operates as both a manufacturer and a representative for multiple hospitality-focused furniture lines. In its own workshop it produces custom millwork, upholstery, seating, tables, signage, and metalwork, while also sourcing indoor and outdoor furniture, booths, banquettes, fabrics, umbrellas, lighting, and carpeting from partner factories. Projects have been delivered to clients from New York City to California.

The primary market is hospitality design, serving upscale hotels, restaurants, nightclubs, country clubs, and bars. The company emphasizes commercial-grade durability and works with designers, architects, and owners to specify and furnish venues of varying scale.

Leadership cites over 40 years of industry experience and a commitment to turning client visions into reality through a blend of technology and skilled artisans. As a courtesy, the firm offers competitive pricing on maintenance, repair, re-upholstery, refinishing, and recycling, with technicians available for on-site work across the United States.
